segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Chaliye shuru karte hain. Free health camp ka plan aaj lock karna hai.

segments.speaker: Lata Menon
segments.text: Doctor sahab, pichhli baar ka feedback achha tha, log puchh rahe hain agla camp kab hai.

segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Main 8 November soch raha tha, par us din Diwali hai, koi nahi aayega.

segments.speaker: Priyanka Dutta
segments.text: Haan, Diwali ke baad wala Sunday better rahega, 15 November.

segments.speaker: Yusuf Ansari
segments.text: 15 ko clinic ka hall bhi khaali hai, maine register dekh liya.

segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Theek hai, toh camp 15 November, Sunday ko hoga, subah nau se ek baje tak.

segments.speaker: Lata Menon
segments.text: ठीक है, मैं रिसेप्शन पर सबको बता दूँगी।

segments.speaker: Priyanka Dutta
segments.text: Pichhli baar bheed bahut ho gayi thi, teen sau log aa gaye the aur line bahar tak thi.

segments.speaker: Yusuf Ansari
segments.text: Haan, aur aadhe logon ka test hi nahi ho paya, gussa bhi hue the.

segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Is baar registration pehle se karte hain, aur limit rakhte hain.

segments.speaker: Priyanka Dutta
segments.text: Kitni limit? Do sau?

segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Staff ke hisaab se 150 theek hai. 150 registrations ke baad band.

segments.speaker: Lata Menon
segments.text: डेढ़ सौ ठीक है, उससे ज़्यादा हम संभाल नहीं पाएँगे।

segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Toh final, sirf 150 registration lenge, uske baad walk-in nahi.

segments.speaker: Yusuf Ansari
segments.text: Glucometer strips ka stock check kiya maine, sirf do dabbe bache hain.

segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Yusuf, supplier ko order de do, kam se kam das dabbe strips.

segments.speaker: Yusuf Ansari
segments.text: Haan, main supplier se baat karke strips mangwa leta hoon, teen din mein aa jayengi.

segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Theek, 3 din mein strips aa jani chahiye, warna camp se pehle panic hoga.

segments.speaker: Priyanka Dutta
segments.text: Waise clinic ka inspection 5 November ko hai, us din sab files ready chahiye.

segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Haan inspection alag cheez hai, uske liye kal alag meeting rakhte hain.

segments.speaker: Lata Menon
segments.text: Doctor sahab, ek suggestion tha. Camp mein sabko free dawai bhi de dein toh log khush honge.

segments.speaker: Yusuf Ansari
segments.text: Mahine bhar ki dawai sabko dena bahut mehenga padega, budget hi nahi hai.

segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Haan Lata ji, free dawai ka idea abhi nahi, sirf checkup aur counselling karenge.

segments.speaker: Lata Menon
segments.text: जी ठीक है, समझ गई।

segments.speaker: Priyanka Dutta
segments.text: Aankh ki jaanch bhi rakhni thi na? Pichhli baar bahut log puchh rahe the.

segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Haan, eye checkup chahiye. Lata ji, aap eye specialist se baat kar lijiye, Dr. Bhalla wale clinic se.

segments.speaker: Lata Menon
segments.text: Main aankh wale doctor se baat kar leti hoon, unka schedule puchh ke bataungi.

segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Koi date ki jaldi nahi, bas confirm ho jaye.

segments.speaker: Priyanka Dutta
segments.text: Promotion ka kya? Posters lagane padenge aas paas ki societies mein.

segments.speaker: Yusuf Ansari
segments.text: Pichhli baar humne bas board lagaya tha, isliye bahar wale log nahi aaye.

segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Posters koi volunteers mein se laga dega, mujhe naam nahi pata kaun free hai.

segments.speaker: Priyanka Dutta
segments.text: Main design bana deti hoon poster ka, lagana kisi aur ko padega.

segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Theek hai, design Priyanka ka, lagane wala koi bhi ho, poster lagne chahiye bas.

segments.speaker: Lata Menon
segments.text: रजिस्ट्रेशन फ़ॉर्म ऑनलाइन रखें या रिसेप्शन पर?

segments.speaker: Priyanka Dutta
segments.text: Dono rakhte hain, buzurg log online nahi bharenge.

segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Haan dono theek hai. Online wala link Priyanka bana degi.

segments.speaker: Yusuf Ansari
segments.text: BP machines teen hain, ek ka cuff phat gaya hai.

segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Cuff toh chhoti cheez hai, strips ke saath hi mangwa lo.

segments.speaker: Yusuf Ansari
segments.text: Haan, same order mein daal deta hoon.

segments.speaker: Priyanka Dutta
segments.text: Volunteers ke liye T-shirt banwayen?

segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Nahi, badge kaafi hai, T-shirt ka kharcha mat karo.

segments.speaker: Lata Menon
segments.text: Paani aur biscuit ka intezaam main kar dungi, woh roz ka kaam hai.

segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Bahut badhiya. Aur koi cheez?

segments.speaker: Yusuf Ansari
segments.text: Nahi doctor sahab, sab note kar liya.

segments.speaker: Priyanka Dutta
segments.text: Main poster ka draft shaam tak group pe daal dungi.

segments.speaker: Sameer Kohli
segments.text: Theek hai, dhanyavaad sabka. Camp achha karte hain is baar.

decisions.fact: The free health camp is held on Sunday 15 November.
Registrations are capped at 150 with no walk-ins after that.

action_items.fact: Yusuf orders at least ten boxes of glucometer strips from the supplier.
Volunteers put up camp posters in nearby societies; nobody named.
Lata speaks to the eye specialist and confirms their schedule for the camp.

distractors.fact: Free medicines for everyone at the camp were suggested and dropped.
5 November is the clinic inspection, not the strips' due date.
